Read Atlantis model outputs

read_atlantis.Rd

Reads the outputs of an Atlantis run and returns the indicators used in the calibration: biomass, landings, abundance and weight at age. If the run stopped before its scheduled end (see is.stopped), returns the same structure filled with zeros, so a crashed run can still be scored by calibrar.

Usage

read_atlantis(
  path,
  prefix = NULL,
  fg.file,
  fishery,
  spatial = F,
  N_only = F,
  txt.filename = "outputFolder/AMPS_OUTBiomIndx.txt",
  run.filename = "PugetSound_run.prm",
  dt.timeserie = 2,
  ...
)

Arguments

path

Character. Path to the Atlantis run directory.

prefix

Character. Prefix of the Atlantis configuration files (e.g. "AMPS" for Puget Sound).

fg.file

Character. Path to the functional groups CSV file.

fishery

Logical. Whether fishing is turned on in the model.

spatial

Logical. Read the data per polygon. Only FALSE is currently available. Default: FALSE.

N_only

Logical. If TRUE, only read the raw nitrogen biomass (see extract_Nbiomass_main). Default: FALSE.

txt.filename

Character. Path to the biomass index text file, relative to path. Default: "outputFolder/AMPS_OUTBiomIndx.txt" (Puget Sound).

run.filename

Character. Name of the run parameter file, relative to path. Default: "PugetSound_run.prm" (Puget Sound).

dt.timeserie

Integer. Number of time steps in each indicator when the run crashed; all values are set to zero. Default: 2.

...

Not used.

Value

An object of class atlantis: a list with elements biomass, landings, abundance and waa, each a named list with one element per functional group. If N_only = TRUE, a list with a single element Nbiomass.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  outputs <- read_atlantis(path    = "path/to/atlantis/run",
                           prefix  = "AMPS",
                           fg.file = "PugetSoundAtlantisFunctionalGroups.csv",
                           fishery = TRUE)
} # }
